node.text.decode.name: Decode bytes as text
node.text.decode.description: Decode bytes from a file or network message as text using the selected encoding and BOM policy. Invalid bytes fail without replacement characters.
node.text.encode.name: Encode text as bytes
node.text.encode.description: Encode text as bytes for a file or network message. Choose the encoding and BOM; unrepresentable characters fail without replacement.
Automatic detects a Unicode BOM; without: Automatic detects a Unicode BOM; without a BOM it uses strict UTF-8. Select legacy encodings explicitly. Explicit UTF-16 takes precedence over an overlapping UTF-32 BOM prefix.
Automatic removes a matching leading BOM: Automatic removes a matching leading BOM when present. Present requires it. None treats every byte as text, including a leading U+FEFF; automatic encoding then uses UTF-8. Conflicting BOMs and invalid byte sequences fail.
Choose the output encoding. Automatic us: Choose the output encoding. Automatic uses UTF-8. Characters that the selected encoding cannot represent fail without replacement.
Automatic adds a BOM for UTF-16/UTF-32 a: Automatic adds a BOM for UTF-16/UTF-32 and omits it for UTF-8 and legacy encodings. Present adds a Unicode BOM and fails for encodings without one. None adds nothing. Text content is preserved.
